capabilities: Tag individual links with {#tag} text on the same line
Tag notes through the native tags property
Search note and link tags together in a dedicated view
Filter results as notes or links and jump to the source line
Open internal or web link destinations from results
extras: Interface and command names are in Korean in this initial release; mobile is untested. Distributed via GitHub releases with manual installation only, and the README notes it has not been accepted into the community plugin directory. No telemetry, accounts, or paid features.
problem: Obsidian tags and search work at the note level, so individual links to the same destination cannot carry their own tags or appear as separate search results.
summary: Link tagging plugin that stores tags as text beside individual links and searches them together with note tags in a dedicated search view.
